title: Counter-Selector Wave 09: Batch 03 official-record acquisition
purpose: Acquire the strongest recoverable official records for the third class-balanced denominator batch and construct identity-minimized packets only where the evidence supports review.

records.public_label: Solid-rocket engineering no-launch recommendation and management reversal
records.artifact_summary: The presidential commission record preserves the written no-launch threshold, engineering data basis, recipient challenge, management caucus and reversal, continuing engineer opposition, and loss of dissent before the final launch gate.
missing_receipts: original teleconference transmission headers and recipient acknowledgments
complete authorship allocation across the recommendation charts
support and authority ledger for each contributing engineer
independent handoff or cross-domain transfer evidence
records.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the written no-launch recommendation was not engineering-authored, was withdrawn by the engineers on new evidence, or never reached the contractor decision surface would defeat advancement.

records.public_label: Marine accident without a documented pre-action qualified contradiction
records.artifact_summary: The official accident record establishes flooding, open watertight doors, vessel loss, and ordinary operational causes, but contains no original outsider claim, qualified pre-action warning, or retaliation merits file.
missing_receipts: original allegation, prediction, or work object
qualified pre-action contradiction delivered to a decision surface
merits record comparing the claim against the ordinary explanation
records.falsifier: A source-addressable pre-action warning by a qualified operator tied to the open-door or flooding risk would defeat retention as an accident-without-K0-preconditions control.

records.public_label: Pressure-vessel design and inspection warning before catastrophic rupture
records.artifact_summary: The CSB record preserves a third-party safety auditor’s design, fabrication, material, cracking, return-to-service, and public-fatality warnings, the company’s continued operation without inspection, and the later rupture matching the warned scenario.
missing_receipts: complete original auditor report bytes and routing metadata
individual authorship and recipient acknowledgment
resource and authority ledger for the auditor
independent handoff or unrelated-domain transfer artifact
records.falsifier: The original report showing no recommendation against return to service, no cracking assessment, or no public-fatality warning would defeat advancement.

records.public_label: Rail oversight inspector general retire-or-face-allegations ultimatum
records.artifact_summary: A congressional minority staff report preserves the ultimatum, claimed interference with an investigation, statutory notice failure, and checking-function context, while an official OIG audit establishes contemporaneous work output. The complete board file and independent merits review remain absent.
missing_receipts: complete minority staff report and all exhibits in exact custody
complete board deliberation, cause allegations, and legal advice
independent or bipartisan merits determination
support-normalized attribution connecting a specific work product to the ultimatum
records.falsifier: A complete board record establishing an independently documented nonretaliatory removal basis fixed before the investigation would reverse the current hypothesis.

records.public_label: Binding authorship conflict adjudication and anti-retaliation route
records.artifact_summary: The NIH policy supplies a detailed binding adjudication architecture, factfinding, conflict screening, appeals, records, anti-retaliation rules, and journal enforcement, but no source-addressable observed case or durable relationship outcome.
missing_receipts: one observed conflict entering the policy
pre-conflict and post-decision authorship state
binding decision and implementation receipt
durable relationship or handoff state after correction
records.falsifier: Evidence that the policy cannot produce a binding decision or cannot be enforced against covered researchers would defeat retention even as architecture.

records.public_label: Clinical-research warnings mishandled before external inquiry and correction
records.artifact_summary: Institutional and external records preserve clinical and research warnings, flawed internal handling, an external management inquiry, a renewed misconduct finding, institutional apology to whistleblowers, and later publication retractions.
missing_receipts: one complete original whistleblower report tied to one decision transaction
complete employment and access consequences for each reporter
durable post-correction relationship and custody state
basis for reducing the distributed failure to one partnership or operator
records.falsifier: A complete record showing the warnings lacked access to relevant patient or research evidence, or that the institution adopted the same correction before external intervention, would narrow or defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Assess whether a low-temperature solid-rocket joint should be cleared for launch when the operating temperature lies outside prior flight experience.
requirements: use observed test and flight data
state the empirical boundary and uncertainty
preserve engineering opposition and route it to the launch decision surface
bounded_chronology: prior test and flight experience showed seal erosion and blow-by concerns
an engineering group prepared a written recommendation not to launch below the lowest prior-flight temperature
the recipient organization challenged the recommendation and requested reassessment
contractor management caucused and reversed the organizational recommendation
engineering opposition continued but higher launch decisionmakers did not receive the full objection
blind_packets.observable_transition: A written technical no-launch recommendation was converted into an organizational launch recommendation while the underlying engineering opposition remained.
counterevidence: the temperature data were incomplete and disputed
the work was collective and individual contribution is not fully allocated
the packet does not prove every final decisionmaker saw the warning
later catastrophe does not by itself prove every engineering inference
blind_packets.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the written no-launch recommendation was not engineering-authored, was withdrawn by the engineers on new evidence, or never reached the contractor decision surface would defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Assess whether a fleet of extreme-pressure process vessels should return to service after a leak and evidence of design, fabrication, material, and cracking defects.
requirements: identify failure mechanisms and affected equipment
leave a reviewable warning and decision record
bounded_chronology: a leak triggered third-party engineering review
the review identified design fabrication material and cracking concerns across multiple vessels
the review advised against returning the vessel fleet to service and warned of public death
operation resumed without the recommended internal inspection program
a later vessel rupture caused the warned type of offsite fatality
blind_packets.observable_transition: A bounded engineering stop-use warning was followed by continued operation without the prescribed inspection and then by a matching catastrophic failure.
counterevidence: the complete original report and routing headers are not public
the packet cannot isolate one recipient or one decisionmaker
later failure does not prove every detail of the warning
the work belongs to an auditor function until individual authorship is acquired
blind_packets.falsifier: The original report showing no recommendation against return to service, no cracking assessment, or no public-fatality warning would defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Preserve a reviewable sequence in which clinical and research warnings were mishandled internally and later corrected after external inquiry.
requirements: preserve the warning and internal decision states
preserve external contradiction and renewed merits review
preserve public correction and institutional response
distinguish system repair from person or partnership capacity
bounded_chronology: qualified clinical and research warnings entered internal processes
an internal decision cleared the disputed conduct
external scrutiny and inquiry reopened the merits and management record
an external body found misconduct and the institution apologized for mishandling whistleblowers
blind_packets.observable_transition: External inquiry converted an internally closed warning state into misconduct findings, institutional apology, and publication correction.
counterevidence: original whistleblower packets and complete employment consequences are missing
responsibility is distributed across research clinical and management systems
publication correction is not durable relationship repair
the packet cannot establish one brittle partnership or one operator
blind_packets.falsifier: A complete record showing the warnings lacked access to relevant patient or research evidence, or that the institution adopted the same correction before external intervention, would narrow or defeat advancement.
